positive_rule: n_OOS>=40 AND control VALID AND M1>=95.0 AND M2>=95.0 AND mean net R>0

slice55_btc_artefact.note: Belongs to funding_carry_fade_v1, which is FROZEN ABSENT. Refused by the deny-list AND by the multi-symbol rule.

m1_margin.statement: M1 cleared its bar by 0.13 percentile points. THREE of 1,500 rotation replicates moving above the observed mean would fail it. The observed mean net R would need to fall by 0.0042 R — 2.4% of itself — to sit exactly at the bar. This is a pass, and it is the thinnest pass the programme could produce.

n_margin.statement: The trade count cleared its floor by ONE trade. EDGE.md §39c predicted this before the module existed, which is why the cut was locked and hashed in a separate commit first.

control_offset.statement: The instrument reads 52.30, not 50, on this window when nothing can be timed. The three-clause control rule PASSED and there is no pre-declared adjustment for the residual offset — inventing one now, after seeing 95.13, would be moving the goalposts against a result, which is exactly as dishonest as moving them toward one. It is recorded so a human can weigh it.

decay_across_time.statement: The most recent half of the out-of-sample window reads +0.0236 mean net R on 20 trades — essentially flat — against +0.3164 on the 21 trades before it. The whole OOS pass is carried by its earlier half. This is a DIAGNOSTIC and cannot fail the gate; it is also the single most important thing a human should look at before trading this.

concentration.statement: Three of 41 trades carry 41% of the summed net R.

HOW_FRAGILE_THIS_RESULT_IS.THE_LIMITATION_THAT_MATTERS_MOST: THIS IS A TIME SPLIT OF ALREADY-OBSERVED DATA, NOT HELD-OUT DATA. The late window was part of the full sample that slice 55 measured to 97.0/97.5 on BTCUSDT — the reading that motivated writing this product at all. No human chose these constants without having seen this window; they chose them in slice 55 having seen all of it. A genuine out-of-sample test requires data that did not exist, or was not looked at, when the rule was fixed. The intake defines the gate as the late-50% split and that gate has been followed exactly and honestly, but a bank auditor should read this clear as 'survived a pre-declared time split of the data it was found in', NOT as 'validated on unseen data'. The difference is material and it is the reason a forward paper period is the obvious next step.

shell_note: Nothing wires funding_carry_fade_btc_v1 into the trading engine and no trading path consults cleared_edge_signal. The NO EDGE CLAIM line is unchanged and was not weakened: it is a statement about this shell, which still executes no edge.
